script: Jupiter has a storm that is bigger than the entire Earth. It is called the Great Red Spot, and astronomers have watched it for nearly two hundred years. Its winds whip around at hundreds of kilometers per hour. But it is shrinking, and today it is much smaller than it was a century ago. Nobody knows for sure whether it will one day disappear.
